Sampled anon/file maxima may occur at different instants and cannot be added; M is the retained-FD kernel cgroup peak.

No per-request deadline is enforced; this is not evidence of passing a formal time limit.

workload.generator: row-local xorshift signed uint8/16; initial seed=id; initial category=c9
workload.timing: SQL generation and external oracle/decoding/hashes/eviction excluded; all measured stages retained; no invented cross-stage weights

Category UPDATE changes every row from c9 to c8; point updates replace first/last vectors. Categories are not selective.
The dataset/budget force full codes not to fit, but quantized-prefix coverage itself requires separate engine diagnostics.
Initial and updated states have six independent exhaustive scalar TopK oracles each; replay after recovery reuses the updated truth and is counted as response checks, not new unique truth.
Census checks every primary key, category and independent scalar norm; it does not compare every vector coordinate.
Load preserves its own page cache for first-query/index construction and mutation phases; recovery begins after verified private-file eviction.
The committed log hash is unchanged by restart; only private trial files are synced/evicted after each shutdown, and one cgroup is reused.
measured_stage_sum adds recorded T/B and takes maximum M; it excludes generation, oracle, decoding, hashing and explicit eviction. No cross-stage weights or formal score are invented.
All five rounds, including negative rounds, remain. Null paired ratios mean a zero reference metric.
Sampled anon/file maxima are not simultaneous and cannot be added; M is the kernel peak reset/read using the same FD.
No request deadline is enforced; separate full fresh-write/update/crash stress remains required.

workload.cache_policy: private inode; verified cold before every startup and cold batch; same-process replay with no eviction
workload.filter_scope: all live categories are c9; c9 filter covers every live row, not 10 percent

limitations: Local exact query-service T/B/M only; no write-phase weight, overall performance score or platform extrapolation.

service_total adds startup+cold+replay+shutdown T/B and takes maximum M; excludes preparation, cache eviction and external truth/validation.
cold means cold row pages at batch start; later queries may reuse pages and derived state.
replay retains the same process, derived state and remaining page cache; it does not claim the >2GiB vectors are fully resident.
All live categories are c9, so the c9 filter covers the entire table; this is not a selective-category benchmark.
Repeated responses are individually checked against independent truth; unique SQL cases are counted separately.
Sampled anon/file maxima may occur at different instants and cannot be added; M is the retained-FD kernel cgroup peak.
Null paired ratios mean the reference metric is zero; those rounds remain in raw metrics and stage E.
No per-request deadline is enforced; this is not evidence of passing a formal time limit.

workload.timing: SQL generation and external oracle/decoding/hashes/eviction excluded; all measured stages retained; no invented cross-stage weights

limitations: This is a small-data indexed-update experiment under an insufficient derived-index budget, not a >2GiB capacity check.
The first TopK batch builds the implicit index; all three mutation ACK phases execute after that batch and include fdatasync and synchronous index maintenance.
Category UPDATE changes every row from c9 to c8; point updates replace first/last vectors. Categories are not selective.
The dataset/budget force full codes not to fit, but quantized-prefix coverage itself requires separate engine diagnostics.
Initial and updated states have six independent exhaustive scalar TopK oracles each; replay after recovery reuses the updated truth and is counted as response checks, not new unique truth.
Census checks every primary key, category and independent scalar norm; it does not compare every vector coordinate.
Load preserves its own page cache for first-query/index construction and mutation phases; recovery begins after verified private-file eviction.
The committed log hash is unchanged by restart; only private trial files are synced/evicted after each shutdown, and one cgroup is reused.
measured_stage_sum adds recorded T/B and takes maximum M; it excludes generation, oracle, decoding, hashing and explicit eviction. No cross-stage weights or formal score are invented.
All five rounds, including negative rounds, remain. Null paired ratios mean a zero reference metric.
Sampled anon/file maxima are not simultaneous and cannot be added; M is the kernel peak reset/read using the same FD.
No request deadline is enforced; separate full fresh-write/update/crash stress remains required.

limits: census checks primary keys, categories and independently regenerated norms; it does not project and compare every vector coordinate
pre-ready SIGKILL is verified; there is no internal recovery progress hook
full workflow has no per-request deadline and is not a formal time-limit pass
memory.peak includes file cache; sampled anon/file maxima are not additive
phase T excludes external oracle generation; no phase weights are invented
